label: Storage policy
range: The server checks the allowed range when you save.
invalid: Enter a whole number above zero.
invalidGb: Enter a number of GB above zero.

cleanup.title: Automatic cleanup
cleanup.what: Removes unused containers, images and build cache when free space runs low. Dry run only reports what it would remove.
cleanup.budget: Start cleanup below this free space

keepImages.title: Keep last images per app
keepImages.what: Older images of each app are removed by image cleanup. Live images and rollback pins are always kept.

cacheAge.title: Build cache max age
cacheAge.what: Build cache older than this is removed by automatic cleanup.

lowDisk.title: Low disk warning
lowDisk.what: Raises a low disk warning and alert when free space drops under this.

criticalDisk.title: Critical disk threshold
criticalDisk.what: Builds, image pulls and backups are refused below this free space.
